description: Set the files of the <input type=file> identified by ref or selector. Paths must be ABSOLUTE and exist on the host running the server (max 20 files, 52428800 bytes each). Options: timeoutMs. Returns: { ok, session_id, target, files }. Errors: ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED (relative path; not retryable), FILE_NOT_FOUND (missing path), BAD_ARGUMENT (too many/large files, or ref+selector both), SELECTOR_NO_MATCH / REF_NOT_FOUND (carries similar_refs), NOT_RUNNING.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Actionability budget in ms (default 5000, clamped to 30000).

name: electron_set_files
title: Set files on a file input
